text: Grace Liu and Renata replace standing Global Administrator and Security Administrator roles with least-privilege, PIM-eligible roles in Entra.
A quarterly Entra Access Review forces every privileged role assignment to be re-justified or automatically removed.
On AWS, they replace broad managed policies like AmazonS3FullAccess with tightly scoped customer-managed IAM policies.
Then they federate AWS IAM Identity Center to oakmere-cu -- one Entra identity, one MFA policy, one audit trail across both clouds.
Next: building the Python automation that enriches sign-in IPs against outside threat intelligence.
